title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY):
summary: Schemes — Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY):

items: o Premium: Rs. 20 annually, auto-debited from bank
 Rs. 2 lakh for accidental death/total disability
o Eligibility: Ages 18-70, with linked Aadhaar and bank account
o Objective: Affordable accident insurance for financial security
o Claim Process: Through participating banks
o Tax Benefit: Eligible under Section 80C
o Enrollment & Administration: Through public sector banks and insurance companies
o Impact: Enhances financial inclusion, particularly for low-income groups.
